critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the fuselage geometry by extruding two distinct horizontal rows of window frames along the longitudinal axis. Position Row 1 (Main Deck) at a height of 0.8m from the base and Row 2 (Upper Deck) at 2.4m. For each row, replace the uniform dot pattern with a series of rectangular cutouts spaced at 0.6m intervals, leaving 1.5m gaps over the wing root area to reflect cabin sectioning.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck)

discrepancies.observed: No visible windows on the forward hump section
discrepancies.reference: A distinct row of windows following the curve of the upper deck

discrepancies.observed: Smooth fuselage surface with no breaks or indentations for doors
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular door frames and seams

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length
discrepancies.reference: Varied spacing with larger gaps between cabin sections and over wings
